Zoglobeck, on of the largest meat companies in Israel, we caught two years ago doing unspeakable things to speed up production.

Chickens in small cages left in the sun for over the allowed limit, having entire limbs cut off because they were stuck in some part of the machinery and other horrible violations.

The slaughterhouse built large walls that hide what's happening in the factory and replaced all old machinery with new one. They promised it wouldn't happen again. But two years later, animal rights activists managed to sneak a hidden camera into the slaughterhouse and reveal the sad truth.

It only got worse. If two years ago it was all about speeding production, this time it was just for "fun". The hidden footage shows workers kicking chickens, playing with their dead bodies, slamming them (alive) against hard surfaces, pulling them with all their might when their heads get stuck in the cages and throwing them at each other. The workers are seen joyful and dancing while one of them is holding a dead body in his hands.

Zoglobeck CEO came out with a statement saying that the workers were immediately fired and new regulations were put in place. Sound familiar? That's because it's almost the exact same statement from two years ago.

Seriously, fuck this place.

UPDATE: The slaughter house is now closed (for good this time?). The minister of agriculture came out with a statement saying that he will personally make sure the new rules regarding videocameras in slaughterhouses passes as fast as possible and that if need be, he'll conduct personal surprise checks in all slaughterhouses. A police investigation is currently underway to get those involved arrested for their crimes!
Two years after they were caught violating animal rights, Zoglobeck is at it again.
